desc: Implement a DP function or table to compute the number of valid alternating permutations given counts of remaining odd and even numbers and the parity of the last placed number.
Precompute the DP table for all possible states (i from 0 to odd_count, j from 0 to even_count, p in {0,1}).

Construct the result list by iterating through each position, and for each candidate number (from smallest to largest) that hasn't been used and has the correct parity (different from the last placed number's parity), calculate the number of valid completions using the DP table.
If the number of completions is >= k, pick that candidate, append it to the result, update k, mark the candidate as used, and move to the next position.
If the number of completions is < k, subtract that count from k and try the next candidate.
If at any point no candidate can be found (k is still positive but no more candidates), return an empty list. Also, if after constructing the full permutation k is still > 0, return empty list.
